title: Detect overlapping room bookings
insight: LeetCode 252 Meeting Rooms: sort a copy by start time, after which only neighbours can overlap
prompt: The meeting-room service needs HasConflict in bookings.go implemented; README.md has the overlap rules and the input size we have to handle.
